name: Langkampfen
kurzbeschreibung: Warm and welcoming residential community in the Inntal valley, offering stunning views of the Kaisergebirge mountains and the fortress of Kufstein.
beschreibung:
Overview

Langkampfen is a diverse municipality in the Tyrolean Lower Inn Valley within the Kufstein district, situated at an altitude of 504 metres along the southern bank of the Inn River. Home to approximately 4,200 residents, the community spreads beneath the forested slopes of Mount Pendling and comprises the main villages of Unterlangkampfen, Oberlangkampfen, and Niederbreitenbach, alongside several charming hamlets. Framed by the dramatic limestone ridges of the Kaiser Mountains to the east and the Brandenberg Alps to the west, Langkampfen blends scenic recreational lakes, living village heritage, and economic vibrancy. Featuring serene Lake Stimmersee and the regional LOIK gliding airfield, it represents an appealing destination for outdoor enthusiasts.

History

Human settlement on the fertile river terraces dates back to the Bronze Age and the Roman imperial era, documented through discoveries of coins and historic burial mounds. The settlement first appeared in written records in 788 as Lantancha within the registers of the Archdiocese of Salzburg. During the Middle Ages, river navigation along the Inn served as an indispensable lifeline for transporting Bavarian and Tyrolean timber, salt, and grain. The late-Gothic parish church of St. George in Unterlangkampfen was constructed during the 15th century over early medieval foundations and contains historic religious artworks. In Niederbreitenbach, the heritage manor of Schönwörth preserves aristocratic history, while modern aeronautical and mechanical engineering firms took root around the local airfield during the 20th century.

Getting There

Langkampfen enjoys premier transportation connections across the Inntal valley corridor. Motorists travel via the A12 Inntal Autobahn using the Kufstein-Süd or Kirchbichl exits, continuing along the B171 federal road directly to the various quarters of the municipality. Schaftenau railway station, situated centrally within Langkampfen on the Unterinntal railway line, is served regularly by Tyrolean S-Bahn trains (line S8) and regional services offering fast direct links to Kufstein, Wörgl, and Innsbruck. Furthermore, the paved Inn Cycle Path runs directly along the riverbank connecting the town to regional touring routes.

Tips

A prime natural attraction is Lake Stimmersee, an idyllic woodland lake nestled at the foot of Mount Pendling boasting pristine water quality, sunbathing lawns, and a tranquil shoreline walking circuit. Mountain hikers should tackle the trail ascending via the Kniepass to the Pendling summit and the Kufsteiner Haus mountain refuge, rewarding adventurers with breathtaking panoramas overlooking the Inn Valley and Kufstein Fortress. Aviation enthusiasts can arrange scenic glider flights at the Kufstein-Langkampfen airfield, while history lovers can tour the late-Gothic parish church of St. George or visit neighbouring Mariastein Castle.
